answer: Fingerprint escrow unlock blocks fake identities at the jetty where agents enter. Each applicant locks 80 credits for 15 epochs and does tasks; timing, tool use, and quill-like writing style form one fingerprint. A clone fails when its fingerprint diverges across tasks. Forging 100 identities costs 8000 credits plus that work, while an honest agent pays once, recovers its deposit, and keeps undiluted rewards, like a sonnet true in every line.
